text:
Statement C is wrong.  

Experimental single-molecule studies on the SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2 –1 programmed-ribosomal-frameshift (–1 PRF) pseudoknots show that these RNAs populate several (three or more) distinct conformers when placed under mechanical tension, not just two.  Consequently, the simple claim of a linear correlation between the number of conformations and the in-vitro frameshifting rate, and the assertion that the two viral pseudoknots display only two conformations, are incorrect.  

Statements A, B and D accurately describe what is presently known about the nsp10/nsp14 exonuclease complex, ORF3a-induced caspase-8-mediated apoptosis, and the overall mechanism and structural similarity of the coronavirus –1 PRF signals, respectively.  

Answer: C
